title: Retrieval-Augmented Guardrails for AI-Drafted Patient-Portal Messages: Error Taxonomy Construction and Large-Scale Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The focus is on clinical accuracy, completeness, and workflow appropriateness of AI-generated patient messages.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion.
